title: Perch Fillets with Bell Peppers in Tuna Sauce
ldName: Perch Fillets with Bell Peppers in Tuna Sauce
ldInstructionsRaw: To make our recipe for perch fillets with bell peppers in tuna sauce, start by covering a baking sheet with baking parchment. Place the bell peppers on it and roast for 30 minutes at 445°F (230°C). Let them cool, peel them and open them to remove the seeds and dice.

For the tuna sauce: Hard-boil the eggs. Soften 30 g breadcrumbs with a tablespoon of water and a teaspoon of vinegar. Blend in the tuna with 15 gherkins and the breadcrumbs, a large spoonful of capers, 3 anchovies in oil, the hard-boiled eggs (cut into pieces), 100 g of oil and 100 g of water.

For the perch: Cut the fish fillets into sections and sauté them in a pan with a drizzle of oil and a knob of butter, 3 sage leaves, a pinch of salt and ground pepper. After 2 minutes, turn off the heat and let them rest in the pan for one minute. Serve the perch with the tuna sauce and bell peppers.
htmlIngredientLines: 2  of bell peppers, yellow and red
